scope: Only the seven URLs in sources.json, not the entire OpenAI website. All section text and examples in the scoped sources are retained. General ChatGPT prompt-level guidance is active; workflow/API configuration and historical examples are not pasted into consumer prompts.

ambiguities.issue: Rigid prompt templates versus natural outcome-first prompts
ambiguities.resolution: Current ChatGPT Learn says to include only useful elements. Headings and examples are conditional rather than mandatory.

ambiguities.issue: Some meta-prompts expose reasoning before conclusions
ambiguities.resolution: Prefer the reasoning best-practices guide; do not require hidden chain-of-thought in generic ChatGPT mode.

ambiguities.issue: API message roles and Structured Outputs versus the ChatGPT interface
ambiguities.resolution: Preserve as workflow/API guidance; do not invent controls or schema guarantees in a paste-ready ChatGPT prompt.

ambiguities.issue: Older model capability and Markdown-switch claims in the reasoning guide
ambiguities.resolution: Mark historical/API-specific advice reference-only; do not infer current ChatGPT capabilities.
